headline: Committees advanced Special Town Meeting funding for golf irrigation and the Peninsula Trail, while the School Committee reviewed Neary School renovation options.
synopsis: Ahead of the October Special Town Meeting, the Community Preservation Committee voted to endorse warrant articles seeking $433,546 for the Southborough Golf Club irrigation replacement and roughly $216,000 for the Peninsula Trail pedestrian bridge. The School Committee evaluated schematic concepts for the Neary Elementary School building project and agreed to request that the Select Board transfer $105,485 in additional state aid into the Special Education Stabilization Fund. In municipal administration, the Personnel Board recommended a 5% total salary adjustment for FY28 municipal staff, and the Master Plan Implementation Committee began developing funding strategies for the town's 2030 Master Plan update.

highlights.title: Southborough Golf Club irrigation project funding recommendation
highlights.why: The Community Preservation Committee voted 4-1 to support a Special Town Meeting warrant article for $433,546 in CPA funds, addressing higher project costs that now total $1,087,296.

highlights.title: Peninsula Trail footbridge CPA application and warrant article
highlights.why: The Community Preservation Committee voted 5-0 to advance a funding article requesting roughly $216,000 in CPA funds to construct a pedestrian footbridge closing a critical trail gap.

highlights.title: Neary Elementary School building project options
highlights.why: Superintendent Gregory Martineau shared schematic design concepts ranging from code-compliance renovations to gymnasium additions, with formal cost estimates expected on September 24.

highlights.title: FY27 Chapter 70 state aid allocation to stabilization fund
highlights.why: The School Committee agreed to request that the Select Board allocate $105,485 in newly received state education aid to the Special Education Stabilization Fund to buffer future high-cost placements.

highlights.title: FY28 salary grid adjustment
highlights.why: The Personnel Board voted 4-0 to recommend a 5% overall salary grid increase for FY28 municipal employees, combining a 3% cost-of-living increase and a 2% step increment.

highlights.title: 2030 Master Plan update strategy and funding
highlights.why: The committee discussed using a consulting firm for an estimated $70,000 to $100,000 to streamline the town's Master Plan update, planning outreach to the Planning Board to seek grant sponsorship.

looking_ahead.what: Select Board review of Peninsula Trail Phase 2 CPA application
Neary Elementary School Building Committee meeting featuring preliminary cost estimates for design options
Proposed Peninsula Trail guided public hike
